description: National waste database, reports and data viewer is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Regional Data Hub group and published by Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW). Members: National Waste Data Viewer; National Waste Database and Reports. Example entry: A interactive dashboard created and updated by the Department Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW). It enables users to view summarised waste data across Australia, including material, waste stream, time period, or hazardous and non-hazardous waste. Data is available summarised to states and territories. Users can also access an interactive map showing location of waste and resource recovery facilities across Australia. Coverage is Australia, 2006 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current and unknown, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-10. Files and pages listed: HTML (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
